chartGroups.name: Red, its fix on its way

regions.why: the regions do not combine into the flat chart, with 2 difference(s), such as transitions only in EXPECTED (a guard in the spec blocks them, or the spec renamed the step): Main red | a revert open and a fix row out --> Main's run going | nothing open to fix it : jbus's pass sees main green and closes the revert

classes.rule: At most one revert of jbus's is open at a time.
classes.cause: main went green at a later commit and red again before a pass saw the green alone, so reverts.close, which waits for a green main, left the first revert open while culprits.judge opened a second for the new red
